summary: s-cart is an open-source e-commerce platform built on the Laravel framework. It provides a foundation for setting up online stores to sell products and manage transactions. Because the official documentation is sparse, you should expect standard web shop capabilities typical of PHP-based commerce systems.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice for developers who already use the Laravel ecosystem and want a PHP-native storefront to customise. It works well if you need an MIT-licenced base to build a bespoke shop.
watchOut: Repository traction is currently low, which may limit community support, plugin availability, and third-party integrations compared to dominant alternatives. You should carefully audit the codebase for security and maintenance status before production deployment.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it typically requires a web server like Nginx or Apache, a separate SQL database, and persistent storage for uploaded product images and assets. You will also need to configure a background worker queue and handle TLS termination via a reverse proxy.
